smallest_supported_claim: The separately prepared tactical-rider ordinary account cannot judge rider approach, counterplay, recovery, or intermittence: a bounded native wait ended at an actual-death terminal state before any player-visible rider encounter or player-selected recovery action.
causal_account: The fresh ordinary account used no debug action.  The player disabled safe mode and chose one bounded native wait.  The harness reported no game-minute progress for that request, yet the returned terminal observation recorded actual avatar death at a later turn.  No player-visible rider was observed and no rider causation is claimed.  The death flow was completed through native prompts and the native main-menu quit confirmation; a native save is not available after death.
